top_signal.title: What made you start your own business?
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone   I’ve been thinking about starting a small business someday, but I haven’t settled on a specific idea yet. I’d love to hear how other people got started and hopefully learn something from your experiences.   I’m particularly curious about a few things:   1 What motivated you to start your own business? Was it a desire for more freedom, higher income, dissatisfaction with your job, or simply spotting an opportunity?   2 Was your business related to your previous job or industry? Did you venture into something completely new?   3 How did you come up with your business idea? Did you notice a problem that needed solving, meet the right person, or stumble across an opportunity by chance?   4 How did you get your first customers? Did you rely on personal connections, online platforms, cold outreach, or something else?   5 Looking back, what do you wish you’d known before starting? Was there anything that turned out to be much harder than you expected?   I’m not looking for a get rich quick formula. I’m genuinely interested in the different paths people have taken, especially those ywho started small while still working a full-time job.   I’d love to hear your stories, including the mistakes and setbacks along the way. Thanks       submitted by     /u/iamchao22       [link]       [comments]
